outcome: newborn outcomes (birth weight, gestational age, hospital stay)
cohort: The study included 9 pregnant women with rheumatic valve disease who underwent cardiac surgery concurrently with cesarean delivery between 2003 and 2010.
finding: Cardiac surgery during caesarean delivery for mothers with rheumatic valve disease was associated with favorable maternal outcomes and no newborn mortalities, although prematurity and small for gestational age were observed in some newborns.
